gloss: to concentrate; to focus; to converge
notes:
One of the most common and useful suru verbs. Has two main uses: (1) focusing one's attention or effort, and (2) the convergence or concentration of things in one place or time. Takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark what one is concentrating on.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}{力|りょく}→集中力：17614_shuuchuuryoku⟧: concentration, ability to focus
- ⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧{治療|ちりょう}{室|しつ}: intensive care unit (ICU)
- ⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}{豪雨|ごうう}→集中豪雨：23883_shuuchuugouu⟧: localized heavy rain
- ⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: concentrated attack
- {一極|いっきょく}⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧: concentration in one center (often describing Tokyo)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう}する: to concentrate on ~
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう}する: ~ converges/concentrates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{専念|せんねん}する→専念する：25369_sennensuru⟧: to devote oneself to — implies giving up other things to focus exclusively
- ⟦{注力|ちゅうりょく}する→注力する：21912_chuuryokusuru⟧: to focus efforts on — more business-oriented; emphasizes directing resources
- ⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}する→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧: to be absorbed in — implies being deeply engrossed, losing track of everything else

definitions.gloss: to direct one's attention or mental effort on a single task or subject
definitions.explanation: to direct one's attention or mental effort on a single task or subject; to focus one's mind

definitions.gloss: to gather or converge in one place or on one point
definitions.explanation: to gather or converge in one place or on one point; for things to be concentrated or centralized

examples.japanese: ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう}する。
⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう}できない。
examples.english: I can't concentrate unless it's a quiet place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧な⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう}して⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んだ→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: Before the exam, I concentrated on working on my weak subjects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The population is concentrated in the cities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう}した。
examples.english: Orders were concentrated in one period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
